_doc: Exact feature names or prefix patterns (ending with *) -> human label + short explanation. Longest match wins. {N} in text is replaced by a trailing number in the feature name (e.g. up_share_96 -> 96). Unknown names are prettified automatically.

spot: The day-ahead spot price for the delivery time; the imbalance price is anchored to it.
spot_vs_ctx: How the spot price of this quarter compares with the following hours (a price peak or trough).
spot_vs_past: How the spot price compares with recently realised spot prices.
cons_fc: Day-ahead forecast of Finnish electricity consumption.
wind_fc: Day-ahead forecast of Finnish wind generation.
solar_fc: Day-ahead forecast of Finnish solar generation.
res_load_fc: Consumption forecast minus wind and solar: the load left for other generation.
wind_fc_chg: How much the wind forecast changed (usually a drop means tighter balance).
res_load_chg: Change in forecast residual load since the previous update.
fi_ee_cap: Day-ahead capacity on the FI to EE cross-border link.
ee_fi_cap: Day-ahead capacity on the EE to FI cross-border link.
hour: Time-of-day pattern in prices and regulation.
o_weekday: Day of week of the forecast origin.
step: How far ahead the quarter-hour is; later steps are less certain.
gap_q: Distance between the latest realised data and the delivery time.
spot_h_*: Mean / max / min of day-ahead spot over the 10 h forecast horizon.
res_load_h_*: Mean / max / min of forecast residual load over the 10 h horizon.
wind_h_*: Mean / max / min of forecast wind over the 10 h horizon.
last_spread: How far the last realised imbalance price was from spot.
last_dir: Direction of the most recent realised quarter-hour.
sp_mean_*: Mean imbalance-minus-spot spread over the last {N} quarter-hours.
sp_absmean_*: Mean absolute imbalance-minus-spot spread over the last {N} quarter-hours.
up_share_*: Fraction of the last {N} quarter-hours that were up-regulation.
hi_share_*: share of high-price spikes recently ({N} quarters)
Fraction of recent quarter-hours with price far above spot.
lo_share_*: share of low-price spikes recently ({N} quarters)
Fraction of recent quarter-hours with price far below spot.
last_up_minus_spot: Last mFRR up-regulation price minus spot.
last_dn_minus_spot: Last mFRR down-regulation price minus spot.
se1_gap_last: Northern Sweden (SE1) imbalance price minus Finnish price, latest.
se3_gap_last: Southern Sweden (SE3) imbalance price minus Finnish price, latest.
se1_gap_mean4: Average SE1 minus FI imbalance price gap over the last hour.
cons_err_last: Realised minus forecast consumption in the last known quarter.
se1_flow_last: Latest cross-border flow between Finland and northern Sweden.
spot_mean96_past: average spot over the past day
Mean realised spot price during the last 24 h.
rg_*: 3-day / 7-day volatility of imbalance prices; a turbulent regime raises spike risk.
rt_calc_imb_*: Fingrid real-time estimate of the imbalance (MW; positive = surplus).
rt_prod_surplus_*: Production minus consumption in real time.
rt_freq_*: Real-time frequency (Hz); below 50 Hz signals a shortage.
rt_net_imp_*: Measured net import across Finnish borders.
rt_mfrr_need_*: Real-time need for manual reserve activation.
rt_under_freq_*: Share of time the frequency was below normal.
rt_over_freq_*: Share of time the frequency was above normal.
rt_*: A real-time Fingrid measurement used by the model.
